chunks: Amir al-Mu'minin, peace be upon him, passed by a man who was speaking with superfluous speech, so he stopped by him and then said:
O man, you are dictating to your two recorders a book for your Lord; so speak about what concerns you, and leave what does not concern you.

key_terms.حَافِظَيْكَ: your two recording angels who preserve and write down deeds
key_terms.كِتَاباً: a written record of one's words and deeds
key_terms.مَا يَعْنِيكَ: what genuinely concerns you or benefits you

ai.seo_question: What does Imam Ali عليه السلام teach about avoiding useless speech?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches restraint in speech and reminds a person that every word is being recorded for presentation before Allah. Imam Ali عليه السلام instructs one to speak only about what is beneficial and relevant, and to avoid useless or unnecessary talk.
